articles.summary: VAN BUREN TOWNSHIP, Mich., November 17, 2026 — Visteon Corporation (NASDAQ: VC), a global leader in automotive cockpit electronics, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared its regular quarterly dividend to common shareholders. The dividend of $0.375 per common share is payable December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record on December 1, 2026.
